messages:
matt (AE): FYI MarinerHealth POC tomorrow. Deal is contingent on SSO (Azure AD SAML), SCIM delta + bulk from Okta, nested-group RBAC mappings, domain proof for multiple subdomains (they use wildcard *.mariner.health), and a signed BAA + HITRUST posture note. They also asked if air-gapped/private deployment options exist for the trial. Can we cover these in presales pack?

jess (Solutions Eng): I can. Need Azure AD metadata (IdP XML), Okta SCIM connector config (token+base URL) or CSV export. For nested groups we accept group paths in CSV (parent/child). SCIM tips: chunk <=2500 users, async import for >5k, default rate 600/min/org, Retry-After respected. Delta sync: use PATCH per user and check externalId.

kevin (SE): For wildcard domains, we don't currently support wildcard TXT verification. Options: DNS TXT per subdomain or point a delegated verification subdomain (verify.verify.mariner.health). We'll document both. If they insist on wildcard we'll need an exception and legal approval.

tara (Security): BAA request requires review. If PHI will traverse Redwood endpoints we need a signed BAA BEFORE ingestion. HITRUST: we can provide a control mapping document (our SOC2 mapping to HITRUST) but not a full certification. For air-gapped: we offer Private deployment (customer-managed) but not for short trials without contract; may need expedited legal/eng process.

nina (Legal): Quick note: wildcard domain verification increases risk surface; require domain owner attestation plus audit logs for delegated admins. Also BAA route: we can issue a draft but need Mariner's data flow and PHI classification.

matt (AE): Action list: @jess produce Azure AD + Okta runbook + sample nested-group RBAC CSV; @tara prepare BAA checklist and HITRUST mapping snippet; @kevin draft domain verification alternatives and proposed verification subdomain flow; @infra-bot create kickoff invite. I'll ask Mariner for PHI scope and expected user counts (~estimated 70k).

infra-bot: Event scheduled "MarinerHealth POC Kickoff"  2025-10-01 15:00 UTC. Invitees: matt (AE), jess (Solutions Eng), kevin (SE), tara (Security), nina (Legal). Link: https://cal.example/evt/MAR-POC

jess (Solutions Eng): Quick SCIM snippet to include:
```
POST /scim/v2/Bulk  -> chunk <=2500 users
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id} -> delta updates
Rate-Limit: 600/min per org (default)
Retry: respect Retry-After; backoff starts at 5s
CSV import: async staging bucket, 48h lead for >10k rows
```

kevin (SE): Example nested-group CSV snippet to include in runbook:
```
# parent,child,role
eng/platform,eng/platform/infra,platform_admin
support,customer/success,cs_agent
```

tara (Security): For presales pack I'll include: SOC2 Type II excerpt, control mapping to HITRUST categories, BAA prerequisites (PHI scope, DPA, region), and note that customer-managed KMS is available for Private deployments (contract addendum).

matt (AE): Good. I'll request Azure metadata, Okta export or CSV, and PHI confirmation from Mariner. If wildcard verification is non-negotiable we'll need legal sign-off fast. Sending presales pack request now. :thumbsup:
